nodes.label: Kiting strategy (hitAndRun)
nodes.rationale: Fighters circle-strafe at attack range; the tanker anchors franky/crabxx to a fixed spot and drags farm mobs home, holding closer to home the more the mob outpaces it (speedRate).

nodes.label: Merchant duty lock (duty / takeDuty / releaseDuty)
nodes.rationale: One cooperative mutex for every merchant routine that moves; the lock object is the ownership token so a reclaimed holder cannot release its successor, and a watchdog on duty.since recovers leaks from moves that never settle.

nodes.label: Never release a lock you did not take
nodes.rationale: Structural rule shared by duty, isEquipingItems and equipBatch: only the holder of the exact lock token may release or renew it.

nodes.label: watchStrandedMoves (orphaned move deferreds)
nodes.rationale: Death or a Cave of Many Dreams pause clear character.moving without settling the move deferred, so smartMove would hang with isAdvanceSmartMoving set; rejecting them on death/cave events forces cleanUp.

nodes.label: Only a fighter's request cuts a gather short (isGathering)
nodes.rationale: Banking kept cancelling fishing/mining walks; while walkAndGather marks a gather, takeDuty refuses everyone except the cm delivery handler passing overGather.

nodes.label: Merchant cm handler trust boundary (OPEN_DUTIES / OWNED_DUTIES)
nodes.rationale: A cm is untrusted input: potions and mluck are open to anyone, item-moving duties require isOwnedCharacter, and the gate runs before the duty lock so strangers cannot park the merchant.

nodes.label: Deliveries outrank the event fight (overEvent)
nodes.rationale: The event loop held the duty for a whole boss and dropped every fighter request; the cm handler may now take over an EVENT holder, one server at a time, and the event re-joins on its next tick.

nodes.label: A failed hand-off must not cost the request
nodes.rationale: One rejected send_item aborted the fighters' whole cm tick, so mid-boss potion requests vanished; each send now swallows its own rejection.

nodes.label: Duties stop at the action's reach (moveInReachOf / stopWatcher)
nodes.rationale: Fighters move while the merchant walks; walks end once the requester is inside DELIVERY_RANGE or mluck range times REQUESTEE_DRIFT_SLACK, via smartMove's stopWatcher.

nodes.label: Realm fatigue and home-drop hopping
nodes.rationale: Home realm gives 5x coop contribution and home-only drops unless a sibling non-merchant visited another realm in the last 30 min; whole-squad hops re-arm it, so settled time at home is the asset.

nodes.label: ServerRealmData (unauthenticated realm observer sockets)
nodes.rationale: Held-open socket.io connections receive welcome and server_info pulses (~24s) for every realm; replaced the aldata fetch as hop candidate source and absorbs the local realm's server.status too.

nodes.label: Event lineup (getLineup, schedule.events/repeats)
nodes.rationale: Per-realm schedule names each slot's event, so only home-table/cooperative events (getHomeSettleEvents) hold the party home; missed entries are ignored.

nodes.label: hopsickness vs realmfatigue
nodes.rationale: Hopsickness (12 min, -80 luck/gold/xp) clears on returning home; realmfatigue (30 min, blocks home bonuses) does not, so only fatigue needs the 32-min settle lead.

nodes.label: Landing early for a foreign event (getEarlyHopTarget)
nodes.rationale: Hop to another realm's Witch round 12-14 min ahead so hop sickness wears off, only when the trip plus HOME_RETURN_LEAD_MS lands before the next home window and no clashing boss is due.

nodes.label: Scheduled windows only (msUntilHomeScheduledEvent)
nodes.rationale: Pumpkin/Green respawns are unpredictable and would close every trip all Halloween, so the early-hop admission check uses scheduled windows only.

nodes.label: shouldHoldAtHome / shouldReturnHomeToSettle
nodes.rationale: Refuse to leave home near a home window and go home once one is within HOME_RETURN_LEAD_MS; guard order is load-bearing since a softened foreign boss would otherwise hold the party through the window.

nodes.label: homeDropRank and kill-time credit
nodes.rationale: Home-table bosses here jump the HP race, abroad sort last; trackHomeBossKills credits 0.25x average kill time because home drops roll at death not spawn.

nodes.label: HOME_SERVER / HOME_SERVERS (per-character home)
nodes.rationale: Hand-maintained mirror of the real home (later readable as parent.character.home); party on USI, rangers on EUI/EUII; the hop owner's home becomes the party's.

nodes.label: TODO: merchant tick as per-concern loops
nodes.rationale: The 750ms setInterval has no overlap lock and runs at the pace of its slowest craft; the plan is craft/improve/disposal/upkeep loops on runSkillLoop.

nodes.label: smartMove sessions and magiport verification
nodes.rationale: Magiport eligibility must compare maps explicitly, cleanUp is session-guarded, magiport is verified by arrival, and per-segment errors abort rather than re-path.

nodes.label: Gnome luring must not scare (lureMechaGnome)
nodes.rationale: Scare undoes a lure; smartMove's own scare interval is opt-out per call so lure legs pass useScare:false, and the handoff waits for a partner to appear after a magiport landing.

nodes.label: Ent luring (dragEnt / walkEntsToSpawn)
nodes.rationale: Merchant aggroes the ent furthest from the first anchor with a dartgun and walks it home, topping the train up mid-walk; aborts only on death or priest offline, with untilDoneOrDead wrapping awaits.

nodes.label: Ent caps as a question (getMaxEntAtSpawn / getMaxConcurrentEnt)
nodes.rationale: MAX_ENT/MAX_CONCURRENT_ENT only hold with a trusted partner standing with the field observer; otherwise both collapse to SOLO_MAX_ENT, asked per tick.

nodes.label: Equip batching vs penalty_cd (equipBatch)
nodes.rationale: Each equip adds 120ms penalty_cd the client learns a ping late; equipBatch slices the batch to the budget before the next attack, with a starvation release after EQUIP_STARVE_ATTACK_PERIODS.

nodes.label: Midas gear overlay owned by the gear calculator
nodes.rationale: Firing all MIDAS_GEAR at once cost ~1s penalty; calculateMageItems overlays it so equipBatch applies it piecewise and midasLooting waits for midasSlotsPending.

nodes.label: Server view of gear (inFlightSlots / getServerSlot)
nodes.rationale: For a ping after an equip the client still shows old gear; sendEquips/sendUnequip record per-slot in-flight items so restores and checks read what the server holds.

nodes.label: Restoring gear before the swap resolves (warriorCleave / warriorStomp)
nodes.rationale: Cleave/stomp only need the weapon server-side at cast, so the restore equipBatch is fired right after use_skill in the same promise array.

nodes.label: Lantern shield's shelter as a swap-in skill (useShelter)
nodes.rationale: The server only checks the offhand at cast and writes sheltered into player.s, so equip, cast and swap back go out together.

nodes.label: strategic_fn math conventions (calculateDamage DPS, healerHps peak, mobbing)
nodes.rationale: calculateDamage returns DPS; healerHps is the healer's peak at 95%; mobbing multiplier capped at max(300/attack,1.2) from 4+ mobs; monster crits included, player crits excluded.

nodes.label: Live character info (character_info.55.js)
nodes.rationale: One reader API for both clients: iframe in browser, sessionStorage map under caracAL instead of localStorage file appends; timing fields published immediately.

nodes.label: Mage gear under the mp budget (mageFightModel)
nodes.rationale: Scores weapons by shots/s capped by mp budget times landed damage, caps hits at max hp, values burn by what procs add, luck/xp gear laid over the damage pick.

nodes.label: Reflective shield on multi_freeze bosses (getFrostballReflector)
nodes.rationale: Shield goes to whichever of mage/rogue has more measured pdps, timed off the boss's multi_freeze timer so the 5s shield covers 3 frostballs.

nodes.label: Stealing a burn earns its contribution
nodes.rationale: A proc sets burn owner f even without raising intensity, earning coop points per tick, so on outsiders' burns a proc is worth raised x seconds held.

nodes.label: Mitigation (mitigation / healMitigation)
nodes.rationale: Server counts piercing twice for both damage types; heal mitigation halves defense minus pierce once; monster piercing comes from G.monsters.

nodes.label: Burn on the server (burnIntensityCap)
nodes.rationale: intensity = max(old, scale*old/divider + hit), converging to hit/(1-scale/divider); refreshed to 5s, ~0.95x intensity per second.

nodes.label: getLoopInterval under 250ms cycles
nodes.rationale: With a cycle under 250ms no divisor qualified and every shot slept a full extra cycle; now falls through to the exact wait.

nodes.label: Per-skill loops (runSkillLoop)
nodes.rationale: Bundling skills into fight() held the attack loop to the slowest promise; each skill now reschedules on its own cooldown with floorMs, awaiting cast to avoid double casts.

nodes.label: Priest heal shares the attack cooldown
nodes.rationale: Heal cannot be its own loop; fight() decides heal vs attack and gear follows get_target(), later getHealee() ?? get_target().

nodes.label: Ranger action plan drives gear and shot (getActionPlan)
nodes.rationale: One plan object for gear and shot; cupid mode only once cupid is equipped; isCupidOnServer reads the server view so a bow shot never heals a mob.

nodes.label: Rogue gear only in the cooldown gap
nodes.rationale: Rogue's short dagger cycle meant fixed-cadence swaps ate shots; follow-up loop keyed on quickstab.

nodes.label: Merchant mluck and drop_egg skill loops
nodes.rationale: Ours refreshed under 30 min left, strangers unless buff.strong, throttled per aim; drop_egg is a real G.skills emote.

nodes.label: Skill loops opt in to running while smart-moving (whileMoving)
nodes.rationale: Detached skill loops lost mainLoop's smart-move guard; runSkillLoop blocks by default, opt-in decided by where the code used to live.

nodes.label: smartmoveDebug must be passed as an option
nodes.rationale: StrategicSmartMove assigns the global from options, clobbering hand-set values, so kite-internal moves pass smartmoveDebug:true and reset in finally.

nodes.label: canUse stashes what cast uses
nodes.rationale: runSkillLoop calls canUse right before cast, so cast reads a closure-scoped pending target instead of rescanning.

nodes.label: Candy-cane swap timing (maybeCandySwap / swapUntilImpact)
nodes.rationale: sugarrush and frenzy are read at impact, so canes go on before the projectile lands; swap back at eta + equip latency, anchored to the equip promise, and skipped if restore penalty cannot clear before the next shot.

nodes.label: Rogue two-handed cane swap and quickstab riding it
nodes.rationale: Rogue unequips offhand then equips one cane, restores explicitly; quickstab procs sugarrush so it is sent with the attack under the same swap.

nodes.label: Warrior paleclaw on the amulet slot (frenzy)
nodes.rationale: Paleclaw frenzy rolls at impact like sugarrush; cleave tail holds the amulet, cleave goes first (isCleaveDue), room in the cycle decides both, mpx swap only when no tail is planned.

nodes.label: Most piercing weapon until impact (maybePiercingSwap)
nodes.rationale: Ranger and mage swap the bag's most-piercing weapon in until the farthest hit lands, then explicitly restore; piercing is read at both commence and impact.

nodes.label: Energize targeting and timing (getEnergizeDamageTarget / isAllyEnergizeDue)
nodes.rationale: Energize goes to whoever gains most (pdps/frequency), lands late in an ally's cycle off published lastShotAt, and skips allies whose published penaltyUntil blocks it.

nodes.label: Field reports must fail closed (publishEntFieldReport)
nodes.rationale: A stale peer snapshot became permission to lure; staleness now returns the blocking value, and the reporter must be able to see the field.

nodes.label: Two party rosters (getMyCharacters / getAlliedNames)
nodes.rationale: Treating our merchant as an outsider kept the warrior from ever agitating; agitate is judged only on mobsInAgitateRange and mobsLeftAfterCleave.

nodes.label: Splash safety: one scan, three thresholds (hasUntargetedMonsterAround)
nodes.rationale: Three copies of the 'would splash wake a mob' scan merged; watchout abilities override negligible; filter the volley not the candidate list; judge gear against the radius you would have.

nodes.label: withTimeout bounds the wait, never the operation
nodes.rationale: A never-answered equip left isEquipingItems held forever; latches must release in a finally with the timeout inside the latch, using allSettled.

nodes.label: Native branch must exclude caracAL, not just enabled
nodes.rationale: A disabled caracAL character fell into the browser path and flooded already_running deploys; else branches need !parent.caracAL.

nodes.label: Script loading is synchronous in both environments
nodes.rationale: caracAL load_scripts became synchronous like load_code, retiring readiness handshakes; loops start at the bottom of the file to avoid TDZ.

nodes.label: Merchant event participation (merchantAttackLoop)
nodes.rationale: Merchant only shoots what someone else tanks, retreats by a healer-dependent hp band, positions via hitAndRun rangeRate, and anything that toggles on its own must not release the duty.

nodes.label: Merchant gear stocking (retrieveMerchantGear / getMerchantGearKeepIndices)
nodes.rationale: Bank trip pulls the gear table for every state by evaluating calculateMerchantEquipments over all states, locked copy first; keep indices pin copies by index, counted in copies not names.

nodes.label: Fighter targeting is a strategy chain (selectFightTarget)
nodes.rationale: fighterStrategies walked in priority order, first true owns the tick; strategies carry their own moves and the pick travels out of band in fighterTarget.

nodes.label: A higher strategy takes over a trip (tripRank)
nodes.rationale: advanceSmartMove stamps the starting strategy's rank; mid-trip only strategies above it run and may replace or abandon the trip.

nodes.label: Crabxx targeting keys off the shell
nodes.rationale: Shell down means the boss outranks crabx; ranger parks off character stack cells; tanker fetches a stolen boss back via coop-gated agitate; stomp with at most one crabx.

nodes.label: Franky: priest absorbs a stolen boss back
nodes.rationale: Absorb only works on is_same(...,1) targets including shared coop id, so the priest anchors on the thief once coop ids match, otherwise on franky to earn the tag.

nodes.label: Incoming projectiles start from the server's roll (ProjectileManagement)
nodes.rationale: Estimates mitigate action.damage; splash is added lazily from current positions; 1hp clamped at registration.

nodes.label: A/B Testing event (roamAbtesting, target score)
nodes.rationale: Nothing in sight must not mean standing still; targets are scored not listed; later fixed move spam by excluding team targets and adding a regroup range.

nodes.label: homeLocation as a Merrit parcel spot (findStandSpot / claimStandSpot)
nodes.rationale: Merrit paths to any qualifying stand within his areas; spot ranked by Xyn reach, first come first served, rejected on server merrit_status reasons; parcel hold blocks lures.

nodes.label: Anniversary visit is a ticket, not a boss
nodes.rationale: The anniversary_visit condition is both eligibility and done flag; visitAnniversaryPlayer holds until the kiss lands since the host moves.

nodes.label: One definition of a weak mob (isDyingToOurShot / isHarmlessMob / isWeakMob)
nodes.rationale: Thresholds in basic_function.7 config, predicates in strategic_fn.11; thresholds are DPS not per-hit.

nodes.label: Pull targets stay clumpiest-first (sortPullTargets)
nodes.rationale: An adds-first experiment cut party dps and was reverted; max_hp ratios cannot tell adds from unrelated small mobs.

nodes.label: Grow spawn groups and kill order (growthKillRank / growthDamageRank)
nodes.rationale: Deaths at L <= 2N/3 respawn in 25ms and spawns at L <= N/2 add temps, so kill order decides growth; the tracker infers temp vs permanent from consecutive ids.

nodes.label: The zapper pulls farm mobs (getZapTarget)
nodes.rationale: Farm mobs sort first when their dps plus party damage stays under heal; between aggroed mobs a two-zap kill comes first.

nodes.label: USE_GROWTH_TARGETING switch
nodes.rationale: Growth only pays when spawns are the bottleneck; the switch zeroes growth ranks to compare hours on vs off.

nodes.label: Overkill rank (overkillRank / getHpAfterPending)
nodes.rationale: From earthiverse's sortPriority: mobs the in-flight hits or burn will finish rank last.

nodes.label: The mage's weapon pays for its own shots (rankMageWeapons / mageMpReserve)
nodes.rationale: Weapon dps scaled by the share of shots the mp budget covers; reserve is a magiport plus two blinks (4100 mp).

nodes.label: Curse what the party is hitting (getCurseTarget / curseValue)
nodes.rationale: Curse value is party dps on the mob plus mob dps on its victims; splash amps through the main target so curse goes to the AoE pick; mobs strangers hold are cursed only if we hit them.

nodes.label: The exchange queue (EXCHANGE_QUEUE / exchangeSomething)
nodes.rationale: keep is held back from the bag total, smallest stack first to spend pvp-marked stacks, holiday NPCs only in season, a walk keeps exchanging under DUTY.ERRAND.

nodes.label: Levelled craft ingredients (craftLevelTargets)
nodes.rationale: name -> {level: quantity} handshake between craft() and upgrade/compound; reservations stop spare copies being consumed; feasibility measured in level-0 equivalents capped by MAX_CRAFT_BUY.

nodes.label: craftQuantity is a ceiling, not a demand (getCoveredCraftQuantity)
nodes.rationale: All-or-nothing ingredient checks crafted nothing when the batch exceeded stock; batch is clamped to what owned ingredients cover.

nodes.label: Sorting must not run between picking a slot and spending it (inventoryLock)
nodes.rationale: Reader/writer lock in one number: -1 for sortInv, n for mutators; compound and upgrade share the lock concurrently.

nodes.label: KEEP_THRESHOLD gates (canSpareUpgrade / canSpareCompound)
nodes.rationale: Keep threshold is not a rare-item rule; copies upgrade only while more than keep sit at or above the level; store pass keeps workable top copies.

nodes.label: Pathfinder rebuild for generated maps (refreshPathfinderFor / preparePathfinder)
nodes.rationale: prepare is all-or-nothing: rebuild on an unknown map with geometry, clear before prepare, cheat paths before prepare, one prepare per build, and fill doors/spawns on malformed maps.

nodes.label: Cave of Many Dreams run strategy
nodes.rationale: Depth over farms, clear objective rooms on the way, merchant rooms settle on attempt, leave allies/victims by side, refused walks back off, cave mobs never report a target so engagement is by awake camp.

nodes.label: Hunting the cave Dark Mage (huntCaveDarkMage)
nodes.rationale: He dies only to reflected spells; the mage shields, walks in to take a cast, backs out; others stay 750 away; deaths are free via Nera.

nodes.label: An escort outlives its vote (isEscortingToCaveStairs)
nodes.rationale: The server keeps only the latest vote, so the escort is read from entities and paced with a leash stopWatcher.

nodes.label: A bank store onto an occupied slot swaps, never merges (buildStackDrain)
nodes.rationale: Only slotless stores merge into the first stack with room, so drains target that stack.

nodes.label: Lucky upgrade slot finder (probeLuckySlot)
nodes.rationale: Hidden per-character slot p.item_num biases uscroll rolls; leaked q_data roll digits are binned and scored with a likelihood ratio; mass production throttled so digits still leak.

nodes.label: Bank purge keyed off keep thresholds (isPurgeable / pickPurgeVictim)
nodes.rationale: Boss-loot jewelry flooded the bank; purge frees a few slots per pass from lines over keep plus escalating headroom, isBankTight is a latch, the gentle valve runs off the tick, sales step out of the bank.

nodes.label: Same-map walking corner to corner (getTautPath)
nodes.rationale: A* over inflated wall corners confirmed by can_move gives straight legs ~10% shorter than alpathfinder; windowed search, used only for kiting and engaging.

nodes.label: Scouting a roaming mini-boss (rharpy)
nodes.rationale: Roamers are never clamped to their boundary; four stops set-cover the cove by vision box, and spots end at the first sighting.

nodes.label: Handing a seasonal boss to leeches (getBaitedBoss)
nodes.rationale: Tanking earns contribution, so with Lone Wolf leeches near the party scares the boss off to them and holds fire, with a patience timer and rival take-back.

nodes.label: Surge mp held back only while a surge could fire (surgeMpReserve)
nodes.rationale: Skill gates add the surge cost plus padding only when a surge is pending, orb carried and off cooldown.

nodes.label: Boss minions only count while the boss is in sight
nodes.rationale: getBossMinion matched natural spawns of the same type; minions are picked only while the boss is visible.

nodes.label: Waiting for a priest only when potions and kiting cannot cover it
nodes.rationale: Mob dps minus hpot1 regen must exceed DANGEROUS_MOB_DAMAGE and the mob must not be kitable.

nodes.label: Boss drag routes (BOSS_DRAG_ROUTES / dragToSpot)
nodes.rationale: Priest tanks and drags route bosses to a spot in leashed legs; thieves taken back by absorb or agitate under isCoopFriendly; releaseAtSpot and takeBackFromParty per boss.

nodes.label: One action loop per class (runActionLoop)
nodes.rationale: Every cast on the attack cooldown comes from one loop that runs on trips too, hitting only safe en-route targets that do not slow the trip.

nodes.label: Town fallback walks inside the trip (walkOnMap)
nodes.rationale: After failed town channels the trip splices a pathfinder walk into its own path instead of native smart_move; same for door walks.

nodes.label: Gear on trips, pull skills off them (equipClassGear / usePullSkills)
nodes.rationale: Gear loop is whileMoving, pull-only skills never run on trips, and equipBatch refuses while towning.

nodes.label: Midas loot as a trip sets off (lootBeforeTrip)
nodes.rationale: Forces a Midas loot when leaving chests' reach; goldm only pays within 400 by simple_distance, so reach is 390.

nodes.label: Agitate and cleave share one mp floor (warriorAoeMpFloor)
nodes.rationale: Different floors meant agitate always won in between; both now gate on one floor.

nodes.label: Tanking priest scores gear by heal time (pickTankGear)
nodes.rationale: Score is damage taken / heal on us with stats projected like calculate_player_stats; last tank pick is the incumbent with a 5% swap margin; idle mobs not scored.

nodes.label: Off-tank priest scores gear by mp and time per heal (pickHealGear)
nodes.rationale: Lowest mp per heal / heal per second, default gear as incumbent with 1% margin so luck gear does not stick.

nodes.label: Priest luck, exp and ghost heal priorities (calculatePriestItems)
nodes.rationale: Situational rules, then luck/xp gear, then fireball/tank pick, then heal pick; pinkie for ghosts with mainhand-first equips.

nodes.label: Tank pick reads raw damage in view (rawPhysicalDmgShare)
nodes.rationale: Mitigated damage moved with the tank's gear and flipped the tank; raw attack x frequency of mobs in view is stable and stateless.

nodes.label: Partyheal leaves mp for normal heals (partyHealMpFloor)
nodes.rationale: Partyheal fired five times a second; it now needs 20 normal heals' worth of mp left.

nodes.label: Splash is read with || not ?? (splashOf)
nodes.rationale: item_info initialises explosion and blast to 0, so ?? returned the wrong zero.

nodes.label: The priest pulls past its courage (FEAR_AFFECTS_HEAL)
nodes.rationale: Fear only cuts heal under a server mode that is off, so priest pulls skip the courage check.

nodes.label: A farm can pin its tanker (tanker / warriorHeld)
nodes.rationale: A farm entry pins the tanker on its spot; warriorHeld mobs (ent) split the tank so the warrior holds them while the priest tanks the rest.

nodes.label: Ranger stalls with no penalty_cd (getShotPlan)
nodes.rationale: A multishot hitting nothing still costs the cooldown; out-of-range crabx no longer blocks a safe shot.

nodes.label: Pinned targets (engage isPinned)
nodes.rationale: Event strategies pin deliberate picks so class pickers keep them; priority bosses (slenderman, grinch) bypass the pin.

nodes.label: One cooldown lead for every skill (leadSkillTimeout)
nodes.rationale: Hooks skill_timeout and leads every cooldown by the fastest recent ping, replacing per-call reduce_cooldown and attackSpeedCompensate.

nodes.label: One respawn per death (respawnWhenReady / commitHarakiri)
nodes.rationale: Per-tick respawns got characters disconnected; one respawn on death with a retry after cant_respawn ms, a reply timeout, and harakiri watched for 30s.

nodes.label: Kill-triggered special mobs (SPECIAL_MOB_IDS)
nodes.rationale: goldenbat, goldenbot, cutebee, paledino, manyeye and mimic spawn from server-wide kill counters near their parent packs.

nodes.label: Cavalry on oneeyes (merchant_cavalry.35.js)
nodes.rationale: Veteran calls take nearest targets at call time and are skipped near level-80 players by centre distance; one oneeye per run, kited at CAVALRY_KITE_GAP, tagged only early in its stone timer.

nodes.label: When a oneeye is surely level 3 (getCavalryMobReadyAt)
nodes.rationale: Untargeted monsters level on a timer; a first sighting bounds when it is surely ready.

nodes.label: Kane's luck on coop bosses (waitOutBossAtKane)
nodes.rationale: Coop bosses roll each contributor's share with its luck at death anywhere on the realm, so the mage walks to Kane's 200-luck aura near the kill.

nodes.label: Native town() settles on landing (useTownWithRetry)
nodes.rationale: Upstream town() now resolves on landing and rejects on failure, so callers need a catch.

nodes.label: Agitate only weighs mobs it can take (isAgitatable)
nodes.rationale: Server agitate skips mobs held by non-friendly players, which previously blocked every agitate.

nodes.label: Halloween events (Horseman, Graveyard, Trick or Treat, parcel sources)
nodes.rationale: Horseman is fatigue-exempt and home-first; merchant fights him only at home; graveyard wave points carry to the Gargoyle; trick-or-treat knocks under ERRAND.

nodes.label: Witch's Cipher gathering (getWitchGatherPlan)
nodes.rationale: Round cut into 5-min slots for the lowest-stock ingredient, one shared plan, witch party preset for ranger kinds, priest tanks the gathering, held spots.

nodes.label: Witch's Cipher brewing (brewWitchCipher / pickWitchMix)
nodes.rationale: fit bitmask gives candidates; pick minimises sum n^2 until the day's crack; brewing is staged one step per tick, strikes only narrow boards, flushes in the day's last round.

nodes.label: Witch's day goes to the first stalled narrow board on any realm
nodes.rationale: One claim per account per UTC day; the merchant hops alone to a narrow, stalled board elsewhere rather than solo-flushing a fresh one.

nodes.label: Franky and icegolem join the hp ranking (HP_RANKED_BOSSES / rankLiveBossesByHp)
nodes.rationale: One shared ranking for fighters and party presets so a fresh Pumpkin no longer pulls the party off a softened Franky.

nodes.label: Horseman party preset and drag
nodes.rationale: Rogue + mage + priest everywhere (shared stack debuff), pinned so Mr. Pumpkin does not outrank him, drag only while Mr. Pumpkin lives.

nodes.label: Bosses before the Witch (HOP_RULES / planHop)
nodes.rationale: Ordered rule list where the first decision wins; the Witch no longer holds the party, the merchant brews alone, verified against live lineups.

nodes.label: Cross-realm rare-mob snipes (snipe rule)
nodes.rationale: Observer spotlight sightings of cutebee/goldenbat/mimic trigger a party hop within the fatigue budget; unnamed realms refused; absorb gamble for mimic.

nodes.label: Party plan (partyPlan / realmBeat heartbeats)
nodes.rationale: The hop owner alone decides realm and roster, followers fit it via heartbeats, one deploy per character per 60s.

nodes.label: Logins are queued by caracAL
nodes.rationale: More than 5 loose sockets per IP get kicked; caracAL's coordinator gives one login turn per account.

nodes.label: Trick or Treat disconnects (knockNextDoor)
nodes.rationale: Failed walks counted as progress flooded stop() emits; retries of a smart move must treat rejection as no progress.

nodes.label: NPCs and doors inside walls (getStandablePointNear)
nodes.rationale: Ring search for the nearest point walkable with 20px clearance, cached per target.

nodes.label: The bank refuses every trade (canUseNpcsRemotely)
nodes.rationale: cant_in_bank applies to buy/sell/upgrade/craft/exchange even with a computer; act-from-here calls gate on canUseNpcsRemotely and purge sales step out first.

nodes.label: Rogue gear by fight model (rogueFightModel)
nodes.rationale: Flat stack after crit, mp income pays attacks first, burn cap on bosses; stars pair handicapped 10%; rogue targets the focus.

nodes.label: Warp vest (useWarp)
nodes.rationale: Merchant warps with a reserved-charge warpvest when magiport is unavailable, vest on/warp/chest back in one tick.

nodes.label: Farm library (FARMS / getFarm / setCurrentFarm)
nodes.rationale: Named farm entries replace map/mapX/mapY globals; anchors shared with the Witch; tanker and warriorHeld ride with the farm; currentFarm is per character.

nodes.label: Kite stuck check relative to the step (trackStuckMovement)
nodes.rationale: Fear-slowed walkers tripped the old 2px check; progress is now a share of what the step could reach.

nodes.label: Party presets follow the realm's home ranger
nodes.rationale: Rangers join mostly on their own home realm (EUI/EUII); per-boss presets adjusted after home moves.

nodes.label: Bean sets the configured home (settleHome)
nodes.rationale: When the real home differs and we stand on the configured one, walk to Bean and set_home; one change per 36h, never set blind.

nodes.label: Bank cache warm across restarts
nodes.rationale: bankCache persisted to storage; reading is floor-free, so the first visit is one floor.

nodes.label: Grace planning for listed upgrades (merchant_grace.56.js)
nodes.rationale: Models server grace, primling and pity counters; planner compares gold per success for upgrade now, feed, or failstack.

nodes.label: Immunity, hunter's mark and piercing shot against the server
nodes.rationale: immune refuses non-piercing skills with no cooldown; huntersmark ignores immunity; piercingshot beats attack near 120 armor; cleave has no xrange.

nodes.label: One impact swap for every class on slot leases (maybeImpactSwap)
nodes.rationale: Supersedes candy, paleclaw and piercing swaps: one value-ranked picker of impact-read stats, kill bonuses stay on, per-slot equip leases replace the isEquipingItems latch.

nodes.label: The crypt run is judged, not listed (crypt_fighter_strat.16.js)
nodes.rationale: Hold model per boss (canHoldCryptBosses), priest tanks with freeze credit, clusters dragged apart, shared sightings, escape when the tanker is down, whole party needed to close a run.

nodes.label: Ripening chosen crypt bosses (ripenLevels / bossAges)
nodes.rationale: Boss level multiplies drop chance, so Lestat/Bill are left to grow and the kept visit resumed once ripe; ages stored on the server timer, growing angerers scared not fought.

nodes.label: The kite steps around idle monsters' aggro (isAggroSpot)
nodes.rationale: Server natural aggro uses a 32px grid and a 45-degree front cone; orbit spots must clear it for idle aggressive monsters.

nodes.label: Merchant banks on bank_u entering each floor at its door (getBankFloorEntry)
nodes.rationale: Packs are reachable from anywhere on their floor, so floor hops end at the door's spawn.

nodes.label: Failstack fodder from the bank (FAILSTACK_POOL)
nodes.rationale: Pity counters key on target level only, so spare N-1 copies are as good as a climbed helmet and cheaper; bankRequests outlive the hold.

nodes.label: Keyed dungeons beyond the crypt (dungeon_fighter_strat.57.js)
nodes.rationale: DUNGEONS read from G with shared visit/instance/run keys, one run at a time, DUNGEON_OPENING caps, victim model for anger/deepfreeze/warpstomp.

nodes.label: Warpstomp, field generators and the lair's stock
nodes.rationale: Warpstomp stuns not damages; fieldgen0 suppresses it, kept in stock, healed by the priest, protected from sales by getDungeonKeeps.

nodes.label: One strategy file per dungeon (Spider Den 58, Tomb 59, Dark Mage 61)
nodes.rationale: Each dungeon file owns its fight tick; 57 holds what they share.

nodes.label: Dungeon kills from the party kill log (priest records)
nodes.rationale: game_log server.kill lines reach every party member, so the priest alone credits kills by instance; ripen targets Lestat 7, Bill 5.
